chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from his brother al-Hasan, from Zur'ah, from Sama'ah, who said:

I asked him about a man who becomes junub, then performs ghusl before urinating, and then finds moisture after he has performed ghusl. He said: He repeats the ghusl. But if he had urinated before performing ghusl, then he does not repeat his ghusl; rather, he performs wudu (ablution) and cleans himself.

key_terms.الْغُسْلَ: the ritual bath required for purification
key_terms.يَسْتَنْجِي: cleans the private part after discharge
key_terms.يُجْنِبُ: becomes in a state of janabah

ai.seo_question: If someone finds moisture after ghusl al-janabah, must he repeat the ghusl?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding ghusl after janabah when moisture is found afterward. It states that if a person did not urinate before ghusl, he repeats the ghusl upon finding moisture; but if he had urinated first, he does not repeat the ghusl and only performs wudu (ablution) and istinja'.
